title: 語音辨識串流管線
subcategoryTitle: 神經網路、資料與視覺系統
subcategoryTitleEn: Neural networks, data and visual systems
summary: 以聲學表示、串流神經網路與解碼串連 16 個原創技術單元、32 步；涵蓋原理解析、架構圖、假想量化、合成資料實驗、競爭失效原因及可重算驗收。
summaryEn: Sixteen original technical units and 32 tasks connect acoustic representations, streaming neural networks and decoding with principles, architectures, assumed calculations, synthetic experiments, competing failure causes and reproducible acceptance.
scope: 公開原理的本地科教模擬與工程判讀。只使用自製、合成或明確授權的資料；不操作真實受害主機、他人帳號、工業控制或超算設施。數值不代表廠商規格或實測效能，完成課程不是專業資格、真實裝置操作經歷或生產部署認證。
scopeEn: Local educational simulation and engineering interpretation of public principles. Use self-made, synthetic or explicitly licensed data only; do not operate real victim hosts, other accounts, industrial control or supercomputing facilities. Values are not product specifications or measured performance. Completion is not a qualification, real-equipment experience or production-deployment certification.

stages.title: 聲音與特徵
stages.description: 四個技術單元依序完成「聲音與特徵」的架構與證據，共八步可分別儲存的本地科教實作。
stages.descriptionEn: Four technical units develop audio and features through eight separately saved local educational tasks.

steps.title: 同意與範圍：原理與架構
steps.titleEn: Consent and scope: principles and architecture
steps.objective: 以「同意與範圍」建立原理、介面與可反駁模型。
steps.objectiveEn: Build principles, interfaces and a falsifiable model for consent and scope.
steps.instruction: 先觀察師傅的「同意與範圍」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：語音可能包含個人資訊，錄音需有明確同意。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「用自製合成音或本人同意短句設任務。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor demonstration for consent and scope. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Speech can contain personal information; recording needs explicit consent. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Use synthetic audio or personally consented utterances. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.
steps.observation: 用自製合成音或本人同意短句設任務。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。
steps.observationEn: Use synthetic audio or personally consented utterances. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：瀏覽器允許麥克風等於允許永久公開錄音。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Microphone permission permits permanent public recordings. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「同意與範圍」兩情境架構圖、假設與可反駁預測，並說明「用自製合成音或本人同意短句設任務。」如何辨別它們。
steps.checkEn: Submit a two-case architecture, assumptions and falsifiable prediction for consent and scope; explain how the proposed evidence discriminates the cases.

knowledge.title: 原理與架構依據
knowledge.text: 語音可能包含個人資訊，錄音需有明確同意。
knowledge.textEn: Speech can contain personal information; recording needs explicit consent.

knowledge.title: 辨別模型的證據
knowledge.text: 用自製合成音或本人同意短句設任務。 保留基準、輸入版本、單位與誤差範圍；這項證據只支援已列出的模型邊界，不能自動推廣為整套真實系統保證。
knowledge.textEn: Use synthetic audio or personally consented utterances. Preserve baselines, input versions, units and errors; this evidence supports stated model boundaries, not an automatic guarantee for an entire real system.

knowledge.title: 本課量化算例
knowledge.text: 假想 16 kHz 單聲道 PCM16 每秒為 16000×2=32000 bytes。320 ms 一塊有 5120 樣本、10240 bytes；若需額外 80 ms 右文，單塊聲學可見範圍 400 ms。模型計算與端點判斷另加延遲。
knowledge.textEn: Synthetic 16-kHz mono PCM16 uses 32,000 bytes/s. A 320-ms chunk has 5,120 samples and 10,240 bytes. Adding 80-ms right context makes 400 ms visible audio; compute and endpoint decisions add latency.

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜遊戲交班延伸：先界定介面
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Campaign transfer: define interfaces first
knowledge.text:
本課「語音辨識串流管線」的「同意與範圍：原理與架構」是這項延伸任務的檢核點。 畫出輸入資料、處理狀態、傳輸與輸出的邊界，在每條箭頭旁寫量、單位、正方向與資料版本。再打開「算力中心：核心不是答案」，比較哪一個介面可類比、哪一個不可類比；不可因為畫面相似就共用數值參數。

需留下的證據：提交一張介面圖與輸入版本、時間追蹤、資源計數與可重播的小型測試的欄位樣本；將假設值、來源值與本次實測值分欄。

驗證與交接：每個介面至少有一個可核對量；提出一項能讓模型失效的邊界改變，而不是只重述公式。
knowledge.textEn:
The checkpoint is “Consent and scope: principles and architecture” in “Streaming speech-recognition pipelines”. Draw the input, processing state, transport and output boundaries; label quantities, units, sign conventions and data revisions on each arrow. Open “Compute Center: Cores Are Not the Answer” and identify which interfaces transfer and which do not. Similar-looking scenes do not justify shared numerical parameters.

Evidence to retain: Submit an interface diagram and sample fields for input version, time traces, resource counters and a replayable small test, separating assumed, sourced and newly measured values.

Verification and handover: Each interface has a checkable quantity. Identify one boundary change that invalidates the model instead of merely repeating a formula.

quiz.question: 審查「同意與範圍」的原理與架構時，哪個說法成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which principle/architecture claim is justified for consent and scope?
options: 瀏覽器允許麥克風等於允許永久公開錄音。
只要一次輸出符合預期，就能推定「同意與範圍」對所有資料量、版本與故障條件都成立。
語音可能包含個人資訊，錄音需有明確同意。
optionsEn: Microphone permission permits permanent public recordings.
One matching output proves consent and scope for all sizes, versions and failure conditions.
Speech can contain personal information; recording needs explicit consent.
quiz.explanation: 語音可能包含個人資訊，錄音需有明確同意。 用自製合成音或本人同意短句設任務。 因此「瀏覽器允許麥克風等於允許永久公開錄音。」混淆了本單元必須分開檢查的條件。
quiz.explanationEn: Speech can contain personal information; recording needs explicit consent. Use synthetic audio or personally consented utterances. The alternative "Microphone permission permits permanent public recordings." conflates conditions that must be checked separately.

steps.title: 同意與範圍：實驗與證據
steps.titleEn: Consent and scope: experiments and evidence
steps.objective: 以「同意與範圍」建立可重算實驗、錯誤辨識與驗收證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Build reproducible experiments, diagnosis and acceptance evidence for consent and scope.
steps.instruction: 重播本單元示意後，僅在自製資料、副本或本地合成環境驗證，不連線真實目標、不取得旁人資料。實作：「用自製合成音或本人同意短句設任務。」；將結果與「語音可能包含個人資訊，錄音需有明確同意。」逐項對照。保留基準和變更後輸出，先列至少兩個可能造成差異的原因，再用版本、單位、誤差或信任邊界排除其中一項。未有實測的數值須明寫為假想值。最後寫出透過／保留的理由和仍待驗證條件。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the unit, then validate only self-made data, copies or a local synthetic environment; do not connect to real targets or collect other people's data. Exercise: Use synthetic audio or personally consented utterances. Compare results against: Speech can contain personal information; recording needs explicit consent. Preserve baseline and changed outputs. List at least two competing causes and discriminate one using versions, units, errors or trust boundaries. Label unmeasured values hypothetical. Document pass/hold reasons and remaining conditions.
steps.observation: 用自製合成音或本人同意短句設任務。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。
steps.observationEn: Use synthetic audio or personally consented utterances. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：瀏覽器允許麥克風等於允許永久公開錄音。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Microphone permission permits permanent public recordings. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「同意與範圍」實驗輸出、基準差異、誤判排除與限用條件；解釋「瀏覽器允許麥克風等於允許永久公開錄音。」為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: Submit outputs, baseline differences, rejected misconceptions and limits for consent and scope; explain why this claim fails: Microphone permission permits permanent public recordings.

steps.title: 聲道與增益：實驗與證據
steps.titleEn: Channels and gain: experiments and evidence
steps.objective: 以「聲道與增益」建立可重算實驗、錯誤辨識與驗收證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Build reproducible experiments, diagnosis and acceptance evidence for channels and gain.
steps.instruction: 重播本單元示意後，僅在自製資料、副本或本地合成環境驗證，不連線真實目標、不取得旁人資料。實作：「對合成波形比較線性增益與飽和。」；將結果與「混音與增益會影響幅度及截波。」逐項對照。保留基準和變更後輸出，先列至少兩個可能造成差異的原因，再用版本、單位、誤差或信任邊界排除其中一項。未有實測的數值須明寫為假想值。最後寫出透過／保留的理由和仍待驗證條件。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the unit, then validate only self-made data, copies or a local synthetic environment; do not connect to real targets or collect other people's data. Exercise: Compare gain and saturation on synthetic waveforms. Compare results against: Mixing and gain affect amplitude and clipping. Preserve baseline and changed outputs. List at least two competing causes and discriminate one using versions, units, errors or trust boundaries. Label unmeasured values hypothetical. Document pass/hold reasons and remaining conditions.
steps.observation: 對合成波形比較線性增益與飽和。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。
steps.observationEn: Compare gain and saturation on synthetic waveforms. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：聲音越大模型一定越準。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Louder audio always improves accuracy. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「聲道與增益」實驗輸出、基準差異、誤判排除與限用條件；解釋「聲音越大模型一定越準。」為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: Submit outputs, baseline differences, rejected misconceptions and limits for channels and gain; explain why this claim fails: Louder audio always improves accuracy.

steps.title: 幀與譜：原理與架構
steps.titleEn: Frames and spectra: principles and architecture
steps.objective: 以「幀與譜」建立原理、介面與可反駁模型。
steps.objectiveEn: Build principles, interfaces and a falsifiable model for frames and spectra.
steps.instruction: 先觀察師傅的「幀與譜」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：短時窗用區域性平穩假設提取頻率特徵。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「計算玩具窗長、hop 與每秒幀數。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor demonstration for frames and spectra. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Short windows extract features under local stationarity assumptions. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Calculate toy window, hop and frames per second. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.
steps.observation: 計算玩具窗長、hop 與每秒幀數。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。
steps.observationEn: Calculate toy window, hop and frames per second. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：窗越長時頻解析度都必然越好。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Longer windows always improve both resolutions. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「幀與譜」兩情境架構圖、假設與可反駁預測，並說明「計算玩具窗長、hop 與每秒幀數。」如何辨別它們。
steps.checkEn: Submit a two-case architecture, assumptions and falsifiable prediction for frames and spectra; explain how the proposed evidence discriminates the cases.
